description: Make a printable attendance / sign-in sheet PDF: names down the side, one column per date for a month (skipping chosen weekdays, e.g. Fri+Sat or Sat+Sun), a run of N sessions from a start date, or N blank columns; tick boxes or wide signature cells; row numbers, a total column, extra empty rows, title, group and teacher. Same page maths as the website: rows that don't fit continue on more pages, and too many date columns are split across pages with the same names. Also returns a blank register CSV. English labels, Latin text only for now. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/attendance-sheet/

cell.description: box = tick boxes, sign = wide cells for signatures.

group.description: Class / group, shown under the title.

mode.description: month = every day of a month; sessions = N dates from a start date; blank = N unnamed columns.

names.description: Names, one per line (leading "1." numbering and anything after a tab are removed), or a list.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

rowHeight.description: Row height in mm (default 8, or 13 for signature cells).

skip.description: Weekdays to skip, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (default [0, 6] = weekends Sat+Sun; use [5, 6] for Fri+Sat).

start.description: sessions mode: first date YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

name: doc_attendance_sheet
title: Attendance sheet PDF
